title: Automated paper-trading circuit breakers, safety sweeps, alerts, acknowledgement, and fail-closed reset controls

authority.gateway: ExecutionGateway remains sole authority for registered mutation tools

safety_scan: no eval/exec/subprocess/network/socket/requests/httpx/credential/execute_repair/apply_repair in saathi/platform/safety/; no 0.0.0.0 binding; token mentions only in prohibited-token lists and docstrings
limitations: local interval scheduler only (disabled by default)
local durable alerts only; no external notification delivery
paper-only, long-only, fixture/replay market data only
